name: Activus Connect
desc:
Customer Service Representative - Remote | $17.00 to $18.00/hr | Inbound Calls, Chats, and Messages, No Sales Expected
Company: Activus Connect
Industry: Customer Service

What a typical day will look like:
You work from home as the voice of the company for customers who contact you by phone, chat, or message. You listen to what the customer needs, give accurate information, troubleshoot problems, and walk people through solutions. You document every interaction clearly, follow company policies and quality standards, and stay positive even when a conversation gets hard. You work with your team and leaders to make the customer experience better. You are paid to train first, then go live on your assigned shift.

Soft Skills
- Clear verbal and written communication
- Patience and staying calm under pressure
- Active listening
- Dependability and attention to detail
- Problem solving
assessment: expect an assessment of typing, internet speed, equipment, and CCAT
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting
Required Experience: None required. Customer service, call center, retail, hospitality, admin, or support experience is a plus.
Preferred Experience: Customer service, call center, retail, hospitality, administrative, or support experience

Required Skills:
- Excellent verbal and written communication
- Strong computer skills and comfort with several systems
- Dependability, professionalism, and attention to detail
- Staying calm and solution-focused under pressure
- Flexible for assigned shifts, Monday through Friday
- Quiet, distraction-free workspace
- Permanent, unrestricted U.S. work authorization
- Your own equipment (see Equipment in Other Information)

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Is new to customer service and wants paid training
- Has call center, retail, or hospitality experience
- Already has a desktop or laptop and the wired setup the job requires
- Can work a shift anywhere between 6:00 AM and 10:00 PM Central

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Does not have a Windows desktop or laptop that meets the specs
- Cannot use wired internet (no wireless, no VPN)
- Needs a set schedule that never changes
- Does not have dual monitors and a wired headset or cannot buy them
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email (typing, internet speed, equipment check, and CCAT)
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening goes, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Customer service
- Inbound calls and chat
- Call center
- Troubleshooting
- Documentation
- Multi-system navigation
- Active listening
- Problem solving
- Attention to detail
- Dependability

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Why are you interested in a remote customer service role?
- How do you stay calm and focused when a customer is upset?
- How do you stay on task when you work from home?
- Tell us about a time you solved a customer's problem. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you had to learn something new quickly. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $17.00 to $18.00/hr. Paid training.
-Shift: Monday through Friday, operating hours 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM Central. You are assigned a shift within those hours, and schedules can change based on business needs.
-Benefits: Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k
-Equipment Provided: No. You provide your own equipment: a Windows 11 desktop or laptop (i5 or newer or Ryzen 5 or better, 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD, administrator access, up-to-date antivirus), dual monitors of at least 20 inches, a wired USB Plantronics 3310 or 3320 headset, a webcam, and wired peripherals. Tablets, Chromebooks, Macs, and virtual machines are not allowed.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Required
-Notes: Wired internet only (hardline or DSL) with at least 20 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload. No wireless and no VPN while on the clock. A webcam is needed for meetings and training. The posting asks for a quiet, distraction-free workspace and permanent, unrestricted U.S. work authorization. Training length is not listed. Previously noted as hiring Oklahoma statewide (3/9/26).
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Customer Service Representative → Senior Customer Service Representative → Team Lead → Quality or Training Specialist → Customer Service Supervisor. This role builds phone and chat support, troubleshooting, documentation, and remote work skills.
